title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Prompt-Dispute Credit on Shown-Pay Adjustments
content:
When a shown-pay adjustment is approved on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the prompt-dispute credit is added after the claimed amount has been multiplied by any share applying to it. It is counted in calendar days from the batch's completion date to the date the shown-pay shortfall dispute was submitted:

| Calendar days from completion date to submission date | Credit |
|---|---|
| Zero or one | 0.50 |
| Two or three | 0.25 |
| Four or more | Nothing |

The completion date is the batch's recorded completion date; the submission date is the date the shopper's shown-pay shortfall dispute was filed.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, batch completed 5 May)

| Dispute submitted | Days | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 5 May | 0 | 0.50 |
| 6 May | 1 | 0.50 |
| 7 May | 2 | 0.25 |
| 8 May | 3 | 0.25 |
| 9 May | 4 | Nothing |
